comments.text: Congrats! Finally a clipboard manager that doesn't feel bloated. Love the search speed.
Does it support Windows 11 dark mode? And can I sync history across devices?
Crashed twice within 10 minutes on Windows 10. How do I get a refund?
This is just a copy of Paste with a new icon. Weird how all the upvotes came in the first hour, did you buy upvotes?
用了两天搜索确实快，希望加上 OCR 截图取字，要是能支持就好了

faq.dark mode|深色: 支持 Win11 深色模式，自动跟随系统
faq.sync|同步: Pro 功能，端到端加密，可选开启，默认只存本机
faq.privacy|隐私|上传: 内容只存本机 SQLite，无上传代码路径，断网可用
faq.价格|收费|pricing|贵: 免费版完整（搜索+3个月历史）；Pro $8/月（OCR/无限历史/同步）
